purpose: Numerical development only; never untouched qualification evidence

construction.amplitudes: signal_photons * detected_signal_fractions[j] / sum(unit component counts[j]) on this grid and shifted generating IRF
construction.normalization: Existing explicit trapezoidal unit-area IRF normalization; no endpoint zeroing
construction.background: Added after convolution, counts per bin
construction.deterministic_target: Exact generating expectation; private deterministic objective path, never relabel as raw counts
construction.identity: Dxx:mean or Dxx:poisson-r; assumed IRF appended only to problem ID, never random seed
construction.pairing: Generate once per observation identity and reuse exact bytes across all assumptions and policies

sampled.provenance: explicit synthetic sampled fixture; not measured

work_contract.model_call: One K-component evaluation; charge three component convolutions, including failed calls with unknown partial work
count_separately: model calls by phase and invocation
work_contract.ceilings: Cooperative checks before every physical call; record overshoot from an in-flight call, NNLS or solver overhead

independent_audit_candidate.model: Separately implemented direct convolution on actual coordinates; independently checked centered Poisson objective
independent_audit_candidate.initialization: Data-only deterministic audit bank; forbid truth and production estimates
independent_audit_candidate.completion: Every required start terminates within its declared work lease, objective consistency passes, final candidate is independently assessed; exhaustion or unavailable stages are explicit incomplete
independent_audit_candidate.boundary_gate: Independent signed Poisson-deviance residual derivative tests at exact zero before TRF comparisons
independent_audit_candidate.interpretation: Independent agreement is not global optimality

evaluation_rules.mandatory_correctness: Every attempt, including failure, must preserve physics/count semantics, budgets, exact returned-candidate assessment and truthful completeness. Any demonstrated correctness violation disqualifies that implementation until a versioned correction.
evaluation_rules.control_quality_gate: All eight predeclared positive-background, separated-lifetime control problems numerically accepted with complete independent audits and absolute signed centered-NLL gap <= 0.01; negative gaps below -0.01 indicate audit insufficiency and leave reference-based eligibility unresolved, not production failure.
evaluation_rules.signed_gap: production centered NLL minus independent audit centered NLL, never clipped
evaluation_rules.robustness: Report remaining 72 problems by declared stratum and assumption, including acceptance, gaps, missingness, boundaries and work. Zero-background D09 is nonregular and belongs here. Do not silently drop or relabel difficult controls after inspecting data.
evaluation_rules.aspirational_target: 80/80 complete independent agreements is descriptive, not the sole production eligibility rule
evaluation_rules.recoverability: Separate truth-based component recovery for separated positive matched cases; zero-component lifetime error undefined; equal components and mono/bi generation fitted with K=3 do not have unique labelled truth. IRF mismatch is not solely numerical error.
evaluation_rules.reporting: Acceptance and agreement use all-attempt denominators; additionally report completed denominators explicitly. Preserve signed gaps when audit incomplete as provisional only. Report median/p90/max wall time and all work counters; deadline times are censored observations, not omitted.
evaluation_rules.selection: Among control-eligible correct candidates compare robustness failures/gaps and paired runtime/work distributions. Prefer a cheaper policy only if no newly observed unresolved worse-than-reference problems compared with a more expensive eligible candidate; otherwise return tradeoff for maintainer review. No automatic default selection.
evaluation_rules.no_eligible_candidate: Stop and report every failure; version and re-review any algorithm, threshold, budget or population revision. Never automatically relax thresholds, increase limits or remove cases.
evaluation_rules.revision_rule: Any settings change after preliminary observation requires a versioned protocol amendment and explicit affected-task replay labels; previous observations cease to be untouched evidence. Historical #28/#33 and A-F data cannot tune settings.

operational_pilot.role: Separate operational measurements; not untouched qualification or comprehensive results
operational_pilot.inherited_fields: Common grid spacing, bounds, fractions and IRF definitions; matched assumptions only; seed namespace suffix condition integer then replicate 0
operational_pilot.configurations: Both adapters, compact start layout; operational-only cap 20000 optimization calls and 60 seconds per fit
operational_pilot.audit: Candidate 16 TRF plus 8 Powell layout, operational-only cap 40000 direct calls and 120 seconds
operational_pilot.next_gate: After implementation review and explicit authorization, measure actual bounded per-phase timings and throughput; estimate comprehensive wall time including incomplete/censored cases before requesting 560 tasks. Pilot-based revisions require protocol versions.

qualification_boundary: PR3 requires separately reviewed frozen protocol and disjoint namespace/observations. Strict 100/100 target remains a proposal, not a frozen criterion.
comprehensive_cost_status: 78.67 worker-hours is the sum of candidate wall ceilings, not a measured runtime estimate; no population generated or run
